about.this_site_provides_registration_an: This site provides registration and login, software trials and formal licenses, device and session management, orders and wallet services, private support and technical services. Each account has one formal Desktop2Stereo license. Online sessions and heartbeats control active devices, while a signed credential permits limited 24-hour offline operation.
about.installers_are_hosted_by_external_: Installers are hosted by external platforms such as GitHub Releases, Quark Drive or Baidu Drive. Obtain installers from links published here or official software-project sources and verify version and file information. A download-site statement is not treated as a license from the original author.
about.this_site_does_not_provide_public_: This site does not provide public forums, comments, groups, ratings or public user publishing. Support is handled through private tickets visible only to the user and authorized staff. Enterprise WeChat conversations are not automatically copied into tickets.

contact.requests_to_access_copy_correct_: Requests to access, copy, correct, supplement, delete, restrict processing or delete an account may be submitted through private support or the email above.
contact.please_include_the_relevant_page: Please include the relevant page, facts, rights basis and valid contact details. Additional verification may be requested.
contact.for_account_or_personal_informat: For account or personal-information requests, we first verify control of the account or contact channel. Our target is an initial response within 10 business days. Complex disputes, payment-channel checks or legal procedures may take longer.
contact.do_not_send_passwords_full_verif: Do not send passwords, full verification codes, private keys, complete identity-document numbers or payment secrets by ordinary email.

recovery.subject: Account recovery request
recovery.title: Account recovery
recovery.intro: If your old phone number is no longer available and you cannot use your password, stop requesting verification codes. Contact us from a reachable email address through the official support mailbox for manual account recovery.
recovery.choose_path: Choose the path that matches your situation
recovery.password_works_detail: Sign in, open Profile → Contact methods, verify the new phone number and enter your current password. The old phone does not need to receive a code.
recovery.old_phone_forgot_password: Old phone unavailable and password forgotten
recovery.old_phone_forgot_password_detai: Use the official mailbox below for manual recovery. Do not use the public feedback form or another person’s account.
recovery.reachable_contact: Email or a new phone is still reachable
recovery.reachable_contact_detail: If your existing email still works, try password recovery first. If you can still sign in, bind a new contact directly.
recovery.email_instructions: Use “Account recovery request” as the subject. Send from an email address you can keep receiving replies from. We will never ask you to send a password or verification code.
recovery.username_and_phone_tail: Your username and the last four digits of the unavailable phone number. Never send a full verification code.
recovery.last_login_details: Approximate date of the last successful sign-in, operating system and computer model.
recovery.purchase_evidence: If you purchased a formal license, provide the 16-digit order number or a redacted payment receipt. Mask full card numbers, payment tokens and identity-document numbers.
recovery.new_phone_details: Explain that the old phone was cancelled, provide your current reachable email and the new phone number you want to use. Do not send a new phone verification code to anyone.
recovery.verify_multiple_facts: Manual recovery never changes a contact based only on a phone number or order number. Staff verify multiple account facts and record the handling in the audit log.
recovery.reset_sign_in: After verification, sign-in methods are reset once and old sessions are revoked. The old phone no longer works for account recovery.
recovery.insufficient_evidence: If sufficient verification cannot be completed, we will not change contacts or reset the account and will explain what evidence is still required.
recovery.never_request_secrets: Staff will never request your password, full verification code, payment password, private key or complete identity-document number.
recovery.page_disclaimer: This page only explains the recovery process. It does not reveal whether an account exists or accept public complaints directly.
